caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a blue glass pitcher, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher has a curved, bulbous body that narrows at the neck, a wide open mouth with a spout, and a single, gracefully curved handle attached to the upper portion of the side. The handle features a slight decorative curl at the bottom. The glass of the pitcher is rendered in various shades of blue, with highlights and lighter areas indicating reflections and the transparency of the glass. The pitcher’s contours and shadows are illustrated with darker blue hues, while white and light blue strokes indicate the shiny, reflective surface of the glass. No other objects or decorations appear in the drawing, and the background remains unadorned and evenly colored.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
